eligibility_bases.ACCEPTED_IN_PRESS: Permitted for scholarly citation when official acceptance letter / camera-ready DOI is issued.
eligibility_bases.ONLINE_FIRST: Permitted when online version of record is published with active DOI.
eligibility_bases.ISSUE_PUBLICATION: Permitted when volume/issue/pages are assigned in final journal/conference proceedings.
eligibility_bases.UNRESOLVED: Target or planned dates cannot be used to infer citation eligibility.

hard_invariants: Planned dates are organizational targets, never legal citation proofs.
Target dates are not converted into actual publication dates without verification.
Missing citation_eligible_date leaves paper in CITATION_NOT_YET_ELIGIBLE state.
